subject.title: feat: add plugin verify evidence endpoint

question: Should the plugin verify endpoint expose only selected-release trust evidence, expose mutable current package config separately, or wait for the vetted-community trust RFC before adding this public contract?
rationale: The endpoint defines machine-readable trust fields for executable plugins, and the current shape can mix release evidence with mutable package-level state; automation cannot choose that security boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Make Provenance Release-Scoped
options.body: Return only selected-release evidence inside provenance, omitting package-level verification and current trusted-publisher config unless those facts were captured for that release.

options.title: Expose Current Config Separately
options.body: If maintainers want current trusted-publisher or package-level config exposed, keep it out of release provenance and document it as mutable package state.

options.title: Pause Behind Trust RFC
options.body: Leave the draft open or paused until the vetted-community plugin trust RFC settles public review-signal and assurance boundaries.

recommendation.title: Make Provenance Release-Scoped
recommendation.body: Return only selected-release evidence inside provenance, omitting package-level verification and current trusted-publisher config unless those facts were captured for that release.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is tied to the current package trust API history and has already offered to review this PR once the contributor confirmed interest.
